name: Fail2Ban_AbuseIPDB
notes: v1.6.0: a crawler rail - an address in a published crawler range (Google, OpenAI) or verified by reverse DNS with forward confirmation (Bing, Yandex, Apple, Amazon, Common Crawl, ByteDance, Perplexity) is never reported; a ban can be lifted, an AbuseIPDB report cannot be deleted. Includes 1.5.x: witness failover arbiter, TLS, health endpoint, metrics and a ready Zabbix module.
